order: Record the second planning session's rulings into the plan document. Close the three deferred audit items: the first is superseded by a seat re-cast recorded elsewhere; the second is adopted as a conscious trade-off — dropping one model from rotation moves exhaustion handling to the human sooner; the third is adopted as a concentration-risk watch with a proposed rotation trigger. Apply four seat re-castings throughout the plan: recast the interactive coordinating seat as the session's own model with a matched mirror, since its core function is direct user dialogue and the prior casting's user-facing prose was observed degrading; move the deep-work seat off user-dialogue duty; set the architecture seat's default and its ambiguous-goal and exhaustion fallbacks; and make one casting the preferred choice for bounded, fully specified orders while keeping the never-under-specified guardrail. Update the status file with the rulings and completed lab-port work, and relabel the handoff-drill line.
claims: We applied the four seat re-castings and closed the three deferred audit items directly in the plan document (three files, 134 insertions, 76 deletions): the status file, the plan itself, and the probe runbook. The status file was updated to record the rulings and the completed lab-port work, and the handoff-drill line was relabeled to match the new casting. Each recast was checked against the guardrail it must keep intact.
